prompt: PricingRule's quote(...) is a final template method with two hooks. Write BulkPricingRule plus a cheapest(...) that never mentions a concrete rule. Complete the starter file, then run the tests.
explanation: The template method pattern puts the fixed algorithm in a final method on the base class and leaves named holes -- here unitPriceCents and discountCents -- for subclasses to fill. Because quote is final, no subclass can accidentally change the clamping and the quantity check that every rule depends on. cheapest works on the PricingRule type alone, so it prices a flat rule and a bulk rule with the same line of code and the right discount is chosen at run time by dynamic dispatch.
hints: discountCents is given the gross total already, so the discount is just grossCents * 20 / 100 or grossCents * 10 / 100.
Test the larger quantity threshold first, otherwise an order of 50 matches the 10-unit rule and never reaches the 20 percent case.
In cheapest keep a best variable that starts as null, skip null entries, and replace best whenever rule.quote(quantity) is strictly lower.
